interface.longDescription: Helix GTM Consulting. Review product market fit inputs and GTM plans, structure launches and customer interviews, and prepare retention, partner, crisis and competitive planning materials. This package connects to 8 hosted rule based tools. The server does not run an AI model or perform live company research. It uses your supplied inputs; some outputs are working drafts or include explicitly labelled example assumptions. Review facts, calculations and placeholders before use. It does not connect to your CRM or send emails. Tool inputs are sent to the hosted service; consult its privacy policy for data handling.
defaultPrompt: Review my GTM plan and identify missing information.
Create a launch plan from my date, audience and goals.
Prepare a customer discovery interview guide.

positive.prompt:
Use this synthetic review scenario, not a claim about any real company. Product market fit scorecard. Use these inputs:
{"product": "HubSpot CRM, synthetic review scenario only", "target_market": "smb_saas", "current_metrics": "Synthetic figures only: MRR $50000; monthly churn 3%; NPS 45; CAC $500; LTV $3000; retention 92%", "business_model": "saas", "customer_feedback": "Interview participants say onboarding takes too long.", "your_sector": "saas"}
positive.expected_behavior: Call the named tool with the supplied inputs. Return its relevant analysis, preserve supplied facts and hypothetical labels, identify missing evidence, and do not claim live research or external actions.
